declare

 select v_operator
 into szOp
 from valid_operators
 where v_operator = :valid_operators.v_operator;

 null;
 when e_toomanyvalues then

 when others then
 raise form_trigger_failure;

end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 nCount number;
begin
 if :valid_operators.eff_date is null then
 :valid_operators.eff_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 if trunc(:valid_operators.eff_date) < trunc(sysdate) then
 show_error('12011');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 elsif :valid_operators.term_date is not null and
 :valid_operators.term_date < :valid_operators.eff_date then
 show_error('11226');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;

 set_item_property('valid_operators.eff_date', format_mask, 'MM-DD-YYYY');

 exception
 when others then
 show_error('11119');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end;
